description: Approve or decline one request to take part in a public project (ids from list_join_requests). Approved, the person becomes a reporter there — files issues and comments; a broader role is given on the project's people screen, as for anybody on the board. Declined, they may ask again in 14 days. The person is told by email either way, and the decision is written to the company's journal. Only the project's owner and its administrators may decide.

approve.description: true to let them in as a reporter, false to decline.

projectKey.description: Key of the public project, e.g. 'LIB'.

name: decide_join_request
